title: FRACMATH: A vectorized MATLAB framework for continuum damage mechanics with crack band regularization
description: FRACMATH is an inspectable MATLAB framework for finite element simulation of quasibrittle fracture with scalar continuum damage and direction-dependent Oliver crack-band regularization. This SoftwareX revision corrects the 2D equivalent-strain invariant, includes a matched Abaqus UMAT, and preserves reproducible material-point and 2D benchmark checks. The archived 3D examples were not rerun for this revision.
